version.benefit_text_en: The maximum premium payable by the farmer will be 2% for the Kharif food and oilseed crops, 1.5% for rabi food and oilseeds crop, and 5% for yearly commercial or horticultural crops, with the remaining premium subsidized by the government.
not_checked_en: The farmer must be growing notified crops in notified areas.
Farmers must have an insurable interest in the insured crops.
The farmer must apply for insurance coverage within the prescribed time frame, usually within 2 weeks of the start of the sowing season.
Farmers must not have received compensation for the same crop loss from any other medium or source.
Farmers must pay their required premium contributions to be eligible for coverage.
